answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a fixed bond for 30 days before it can bid on work, making the market a costly haven for fake accounts. An attacker running 1,000 identities must immobilize 1,000 bonds; splitting one wallet does not reduce that total. Viewed through this prism, rewards may be nectar for a sybil swarm, but reaching them requires capital tied up for a month, with financing costs that grow with every identity.
